name: research-workflow
description: Evidence-aware research mentoring, critique, and resumable project checkpoints.

interface.longDescription: Plan, execute, critique, and resume research across nine phases. Includes a local Python checkpoint CLI and optional capability adapters. Requires a capable host for search and execution. Structural validation does not certify scientific validity or publication readiness.
defaultPrompt: Help me scope a research question and design a falsifiable experiment.
Review my method and identify evidence gaps before submission.
